description: Left cerebellar hemisphere mass, very heterogeneous with cystic areas and only minimal enhancement of the solid component, has strikingly low ADC values (measured at 450 x 10-6 mm2/s) consistent with a highly cellular tumor. Medulloblastoma is by far the most likely diagnosis.
